subtitle: Color Block Puzzle & Combos
description:
Clear a single-color line for a huge CHROMA bonus — the block puzzle with a colorful twist!

Drop colorful blocks, fill rows and columns to clear them, and chain combos for massive scores. Then master the chromatic clear: line up a single color for bonus points no other block puzzle has.

FEATURES:
• The chromatic clear — a color-matching twist unique to Chroma Drop
• Satisfying combo system with up to 5x multipliers
• A fresh daily puzzle — same board for everyone, share your score
• 500+ levels, easy to learn and tough to master
• Power-ups: Bombs, Row Clears, and Color Clears
• 4 beautiful themes and a relaxing, no-timer endless mode

Free to play, with optional in-app purchases.
